_comment: Weights and thresholds for the deterministic recommendation scorer (next/recommend.js; brief §11). Tunable without code. Points are added per product: an intent the visitor chose from a suggestion is 'explicit' and lands on `explicitPrimaryMatch` when it is one of the product's primary intentTags; an intent read out of free text (model or keywords) is 'inferred' and lands on `primaryMatch`. Any detected intent that sits in a product's secondary tags earns `secondaryMatch`. Being in the visitor's goal candidate list earns `goalAlignment`. Bands (company size, creator volume, geography) score a fit when the product declares the visitor's band, a mismatch when the product declares bands and the visitor's is not one of them. A product's `excludesIntents` in solutions.json is the 'use-case mismatch'. Confidence: HIGH needs the top score at or above `minTopScore` AND a lead of at least `highGap` over the runner-up; MEDIUM needs the top score at or above `minTopScore` and a lead of at least `mediumGap`; anything else is LOW. The client's order (2026-09-10) is: what to solve, website, what was found about it, company size, role, then the recommendation — so the opening questions in questions.json carry `first`, and a discriminating question is asked only when there is no intent to recommend from (`discriminateOnlyWithoutIntent`), at most `maxQuestions` times.

pointers._note: Way-finding shown before the next question (Amy, 2026-09-10). With a top score at or above minTopScore the running is pointed at (up to fromReco products); with only a goal, the goal's first fromGoal candidates are named instead. A goal alone scores goalAlignment, so minTopScore above that keeps a bare goal from reading as a recommendation.

conversation._siblingNote: Two products the words alone cannot separate (client sheet, 2026-09-16). When the top two of the ranking are a listed pair and the gap between them is at most pairGap, ONE discriminating question whose `separates` covers both is asked — before the cards, ahead of the size and the role (select-question.js). It is never asked after them: once size and role are in, the client's order of 2026-09-10 stands and a level pair is shown as two cards. IMAI / the SMB platform are deliberately NOT a pair: the company size decides them, both are shown until it is known. It spends the discriminator budget.
